entries.source: Deceive
entries.translation: 欺诈

entries.source:
Instantaneously blink away and leave behind a decoy that lasts for (duration).
<lb>This ##skill triggers your On Dash Effects.<lb>
The decoy ##attacks Enemies dealing (damage) Damage. The decoy's attack speed is equal to yours.
(CastTime)
entries.translation:
瞬间闪烁离开，并留下一个持续(duration)的诱饵。
<lb>该##技能会触发你的冲刺时效果。<lb>
诱饵会##攻击敌人，造成(damage)伤害。诱饵的攻击速度与你相同。
(CastTime)

entries.source: Blink away and leave behind a decoy. Enemies will ##attack the decoy for a short duration.
entries.translation: 闪烁离开并留下诱饵。敌人会在短时间内##攻击诱饵。

entries.source: Rend
entries.translation: 撕裂

entries.source:
Deal (damage) Damage to Enemies around you and inflict Bleed.
<lb>If a target was already Bleeding, tick the Bleed (ticks) times in rapid succession.<lb>
(scaling)
(CastTime)
entries.translation:
对周围敌人造成(damage)伤害并施加流血。
<lb>如果目标已经流血，则快速连续触发(ticks)次流血。<lb>
(scaling)
(CastTime)

entries.source:
Deal Slashing Damage to Enemies around you and inflict Bleed.
If the target is Bleeding already, instead tick the Bleed multiple times.
entries.translation:
对周围敌人造成斩击伤害并施加流血。
如果目标已经流血，则改为连续触发多次流血。

entries.source: Magical Portal
entries.translation: 魔法传送门

entries.source:
Exit the current Room and get transported to a random Event Room on this Floor.<lb>
Cannot be used during combat.<lb>
Cannot be used during or after Boss Encounters.<lb>
Cannot be used if Floor has no Event Rooms.<lb>
(CastTime)
entries.translation:
离开当前房间并传送到本层随机事件房间。<lb>
战斗中无法使用。<lb>
首领战遭遇期间或之后无法使用。<lb>
本层没有事件房间时无法使用。<lb>
(CastTime)

entries.source: Teleport yourself to a random Event Room.
entries.translation: 传送到随机事件房间。

entries.source: Town Portal
entries.translation: 城镇传送门

entries.source:
Flee from the current Room and get transported to a Tavern.<lb>
Cannot be used during or after Boss Encounters.<lb>
(CastTime)
entries.translation:
逃离当前房间并传送到酒馆。<lb>
首领战遭遇期间或之后无法使用。<lb>
(CastTime)

entries.source: Flee from the current Room and teleport yourself to a Tavern.
entries.translation: 逃离当前房间并传送到酒馆。

entries.source: Dashing Strike
entries.translation: 冲刺打击

entries.source:
Dash into a direction and deal (damage) Damage to every Enemy you strike.
<lb>This ##skill inflicts (stacks) stacks of any stacking effect at once.<lb>
This ##skill triggers your On Dash Effects.<lb>
(scaling)
(CastTime)
entries.translation:
向一个方向冲刺，对撞到的每个敌人造成(damage)伤害。
<lb>该##技能会一次性施加任意可叠加效果的(stacks)层。<lb>
该##技能会触发你的冲刺时效果。<lb>
(scaling)
(CastTime)

entries.source: Dash into a direction and deal Slashing Damage to every Enemy you strike.
entries.translation: 向一个方向冲刺，对撞到的每个敌人造成斩击伤害。

entries.source: Wild Shape
entries.translation: 野性变形

entries.source:
Transform into a Bear, Monkey or Owl for (duration) seconds, replacing your Weapon Attack and granting an Effect.<lb>
(bear)<lb>
(monkey)<lb>
(owl)<lb>(scaling)
(CastTime)
entries.translation:
变形成熊、猴子或猫头鹰，持续(duration)秒，替换你的武器攻击并赋予一种效果。<lb>
(bear)<lb>
(monkey)<lb>
(owl)<lb>(scaling)
(CastTime)

entries.source: Transform into a Bear, Monkey or Owl for a short duration.
entries.translation: 变形成熊、猴子或猫头鹰，持续一小段时间。

entries.source: Flex
entries.translation: 展示肌肉

entries.source:
Stand still and flex your muscles, becoming Invulnerable for (invulnTime) seconds.<lb>
If you would have taken damage in that time, gain (bonus) for (duration).<lb>
Your muscles astonish all Enemies in the room dealing (damage) Damage.
(CastTime)
entries.translation:
站立不动展示肌肉，获得无敌，持续(invulnTime)秒。<lb>
如果这段时间内本应受到伤害，则获得(bonus)，持续(duration)。<lb>
你的肌肉让房间内所有敌人惊叹，并造成(damage)伤害。
(CastTime)

entries.source: Flex your muscles and become Invulnerable  for a short duration. If you would have taken damage in that duration, gain an Attack Speed Buff.
entries.translation: 展示肌肉并获得一小段时间的无敌。如果这段时间内本应受到伤害，则获得攻击速度增益。

entries.source: Piercing Volley
entries.translation: 穿刺齐射

entries.source:
Shoot a volley of piercing arrows that deals (damage) Damage.<lb>
(scaling)
(CastTime)
entries.translation:
射出一轮穿刺箭，造成(damage)伤害。<lb>
(scaling)
(CastTime)

entries.source: Shoot a volley of piercing arrows that deals Thrusting Damage.
entries.translation: 射出一轮穿刺箭，造成穿刺伤害。

entries.source: Guard Bash
entries.translation: 盾牌猛击

entries.source:
Bash into the direction you are currently aiming at, dealing (damage) Damage and destroying Enemy Projectiles.<lb>
Covers a larger area while wearing a Shield.<lb>
(CastTime)
(scaling)
entries.translation:
向当前瞄准方向猛击，造成(damage)伤害并摧毁敌方投射物。<lb>
装备盾牌时覆盖更大范围。<lb>
(CastTime)
(scaling)

entries.source: Deal Striking Damage in a cone and clear the area of Enemy Projectiles.
entries.translation: 在锥形区域造成打击伤害并清除敌方投射物。

entries.source: Parry
entries.translation: 招架

entries.source:
Parry into the direction you are currently aiming at, destroying enemy projectiles and deflecting them dealing (damage) Damage.
<lb>This damage massively increases depending on the projectile.<lb>
(scaling)
(CastTime)
entries.translation:
向当前瞄准方向招架，摧毁敌方投射物并将其偏转，造成(damage)伤害。
<lb>该伤害会根据投射物大幅提高。<lb>
(scaling)
(CastTime)

entries.source: Parry Enemy Projectiles, retaliating with Physical Damage.
entries.translation: 招架敌方投射物，以物理伤害反击。

entries.source: Super Flight
entries.translation: 超级飞行

entries.source:
Fly up in the air and become intangible for (duration) before dropping down and smashing the ground with your Fists dealing (damage) Damage in a large area.<lb>
After landing, your invincibility after taking damage starts.<lb>
(scaling)
(CastTime)
entries.translation:
飞上空中并变得无形，持续(duration)，随后落下，用拳头砸击地面，在大范围内造成(damage)伤害。<lb>
落地后，你受到伤害时的无敌效果开始生效。<lb>
(scaling)
(CastTime)

entries.source: Fly up in the air, before dropping down and smashing the ground with your Fists to deal massive Striking Damage.
entries.translation: 飞上空中，随后落下用拳头砸击地面，造成巨额打击伤害。

entries.source: Magic Circle
entries.translation: 魔法阵

entries.source:
Create a ##magic circle on the ground. While standing inside the circle you deal (bonus).
<lb>The circle lasts forever but only [[1]] circle can exist at a time.<lb>
(CastTime)
entries.translation:
在地面创造一个##魔法阵。站在法阵内时，你会造成(bonus)。
<lb>法阵会永久存在，但同时只能有[[1]]个法阵。<lb>
(CastTime)

entries.source: Create a circle on the ground that grants you a Damage Buff while you stand in it. The Buff scales with your amount of Mana<Mana>.
entries.translation: 在地面创造一个法阵，站在其中时获得伤害增益。增益会随你的法力<Mana>数量缩放。

entries.source: High Noon
entries.translation: 正午

entries.source:
Unload [[6]] shots at up to [[6]] Enemies on screen, prioritizing weakest enemies.<lb>
Each shot deals (damage) Damage and has [[100%]] Lucky Hit Chance<Luck>.<lb>
(scaling)
(CastTime)
entries.translation:
向屏幕上最多[[6]]个敌人射出[[6]]发子弹，优先攻击最弱的敌人。<lb>
每发造成(damage)伤害，并拥有[[100%]]幸运命中率<Luck>。<lb>
(scaling)
(CastTime)

entries.source: Unload [[6]] shots at up to [[6]] Enemies dealing Thrusting Damage and guaranteed Lucky Hits<Luck>.
entries.translation: 向最多[[6]]个敌人射出[[6]]发子弹，造成穿刺伤害并保证幸运命中<Luck>。

entries.source: Consecrate
entries.translation: 祝圣

entries.source:
A light shines down inflicting [[10]] [[permanent]] stacks of Glitter and dealing (damage) Damage [[10]] times.
<lb>When used outside of combat, this ##skill can cleanse a door from being Cursed<Curse>.<lb>
(CastTime)
entries.translation:
一道光芒照下，施加[[10]]层[[永久]]闪耀，并造成(damage)伤害[[10]]次。
<lb>在战斗外使用时，该##技能可以净化被诅咒<Curse>的门。<lb>
(CastTime)

entries.source:
Deals Radiant Damage and inflicts [[permanent]] Glitter.
Can cleanse Doors from Curse<Curse>.
entries.translation:
造成辉光伤害并施加[[永久]]闪耀。
可以净化被诅咒<Curse>的门。

entries.source: Arrest
entries.translation: 逮捕

entries.source:
Shackle an Enemy, [[permanently]] applying (debuff) and dealing (damage) Damage.<lb>
If the Enemy is Enchanted the Debuff is applied to the entire pack and the packs Enchantment is removed.<lb>
(CastTime)
entries.translation:
束缚一个敌人，[[永久]]施加(debuff)并造成(damage)伤害。<lb>
如果敌人被附魔，减益会施加给整群敌人，并移除该群的附魔。<lb>
(CastTime)

entries.source: Arrest an Enemy, inflicting a Debuff and removing its Enchantment Modifiers.
entries.translation: 逮捕敌人，施加减益并移除其附魔修正。

entries.source: Pickpocket
entries.translation: 扒窃

entries.source:
Pickpocket a selected target.<lb>
Can be used on enemies and non-hostile creatures, but only once per target.<lb>
Once per run, using this on a non-hostile creature adds [[+1]] Evil<Evil>.<lb>
(CastTime)
entries.translation:
扒窃选定目标。<lb>
可对敌人与非敌对生物使用，但每个目标只能使用一次。<lb>
每次冒险中，对非敌对生物使用一次会增加[[+1]]邪恶<Evil>。<lb>
(CastTime)

entries.source: Steal something from a selected target. Can result in Gold<Gold>, Souls<Soul>, Items and many other things.
entries.translation: 从选定目标那里偷取物品。可能获得金币<Gold>、灵魂<Soul>、物品及许多其他东西。

entries.source: Charisma
entries.translation: 魅惑

entries.source:
Inflicts [[permanent]] Charm to an Enemy.<lb>
Can be used on non-hostile creatures to ##charm them, reducing the price of their service by (discount).<lb>
If they don't provide a service that costs something, they will instead give you a Gift Box.<lb>
(CastTime)
entries.translation:
对敌人施加[[永久]]魅惑。<lb>
可对非敌对生物使用##魅惑，按(discount)降低其服务价格。<lb>
如果它们不提供需要付费的服务，就会改为送你一个礼物盒。<lb>
(CastTime)

entries.source: Inflict [[permanent]] Charm to an Enemy or gain the favour of any non-hostile creature.
entries.translation: 对敌人施加[[永久]]魅惑，或赢得任意非敌对生物的好感。

entries.source: Jinx
entries.translation: 厄运

entries.source:
Jinx all enemies on screen applying [[10]] [[permanent]] stacks of Gloom.
<lb>When used outside of combat, this ##skill can Curse<Curse> Doors to upgrade Rewards if possible.<lb>
(CastTime)
entries.translation:
对屏幕上所有敌人施加[[10]]层[[永久]]阴霾。
<lb>在战斗外使用时，该##技能可以诅咒<Curse>门，在可能的情况下升级奖励。<lb>
(CastTime)

entries.source: Jinx all Enemies to inflict [[permanent]] Gloom on them or Curse<Curse> Doors to upgrade their Rewards if possible.
entries.translation: 对所有敌人施加厄运，使其获得[[永久]]阴霾；也可以诅咒<Curse>门，在可能的情况下升级奖励。

entries.source: Polymorph
entries.translation: 变羊术

entries.source:
Turn an enemy into a harmless sheep.<lb>
Cannot be used on Bosses.<lb>
Can also be used on Treasure Chests and Shrines. Use with caution!<lb>
(CastTime)
entries.translation:
将敌人变成无害的绵羊。<lb>
无法对首领使用。<lb>
也可对宝箱和圣坛使用。谨慎行事！<lb>
(CastTime)

entries.source:
Turn an enemy into a harmless sheep.
Can also be used on Treasure Chests and Shrines at your own risk!
entries.translation:
将敌人变成无害的绵羊。
也可对宝箱和圣坛使用，风险自负！

entries.source: Jump
entries.translation: 跳跃

entries.source:
Turn intangible and jump to a targeted location dealing (damage) Damage where you land.
<lb>Wielding a Spear or Polearm extends the maximum distance.
<lb>If you land close to an enemy, your invincibility after taking damage starts.
<lb>This ##skill triggers your On Dash Effects.<lb>
(scaling)
(CastTime)
entries.translation:
变得无形并跳向目标位置，在落点造成(damage)伤害。
<lb>持有长矛或长柄武器会提高最大距离。
<lb>如果落在敌人附近，你受到伤害时的无敌效果开始生效。
<lb>该##技能会触发你的冲刺时效果。<lb>
(scaling)
(CastTime)

entries.source: Jump to a targeted location dealing Physical Damage in an area.
entries.translation: 跳向目标位置，在区域内造成物理伤害。

entries.source: Smoke Grenade
entries.translation: 烟雾弹

entries.source:
Throw a smoke grenade that inflicts Confusion to enemies inside it for (duration).<lb>
If Explosion Damage touches the smoke, it will ignite it and deal (damage) Damage.<lb>
(scaling)
(CastTime)
entries.translation:
投掷烟雾弹，使其中的敌人陷入混乱，持续(duration)。<lb>
如果爆炸伤害接触烟雾，就会点燃烟雾并造成(damage)伤害。<lb>
(scaling)
(CastTime)

entries.source: Throw a smoke grenade that inflicts Confusion and explodes when ignited by Explosion Damage.
entries.translation: 投掷烟雾弹，使敌人陷入混乱，并在被爆炸伤害点燃时爆炸。

entries.source: Flame Wall
entries.translation: 火焰墙

entries.source:
Create a trench of ##fire that deals (damage) Damage (tickRate) for (duration).
<lb>Projectiles fired through the wall by you or your allies gain (bonusDamage) Damage.<lb>
(scaling)
(CastTime)
entries.translation:
制造一道##火焰壕沟，造成(damage)伤害，每(tickRate)持续(duration)。
<lb>你或盟友穿过墙壁发射的投射物获得(bonusDamage)伤害。<lb>
(scaling)
(CastTime)

entries.source: Create a trench of flames that deals Fire Damage. Projectiles fired through the wall deal additional Fire Damage.
entries.translation: 制造一道火焰壕沟，造成火焰伤害。穿过火焰墙发射的投射物会造成额外火焰伤害。

entries.source: Frost Nova
entries.translation: 冰霜新星

entries.source:
Deal (damage) Damage to enemies around you, creating frozen ground that inflicts Chill and lasts for (duration).<lb>
(scaling)
(CastTime)
entries.translation:
对周围敌人造成(damage)伤害，创造一片造成寒冷并持续(duration)的冻土地面。<lb>
(scaling)
(CastTime)

entries.source: Emit a nova of frost around you, dealing Cold Damage and leaving behind frozen ground that inflicts Chill.
entries.translation: 在周围释放冰霜新星，造成寒冷伤害，并留下会施加寒冷的冻土地面。

entries.source: Mimic
entries.translation: 拟态

entries.source: Mimic the Skill of your current form.
entries.translation: 模仿当前形态的技能。

entries.source: Mimic the Skill of the Class you currently take the form of.
entries.translation: 模仿你当前变身职业的技能。

entries.source: Missile Storm
entries.translation: 导弹风暴

entries.source:
Unleash a barrage of missiles for (duration), ##firing a seeking missile (tickRate), dealing (damage) Damage.<lb>
(scaling)
(CastTime)
entries.translation:
释放持续(duration)的导弹弹幕，##发射追踪导弹，每(tickRate)发射一次，造成(damage)伤害。<lb>
(scaling)
(CastTime)

entries.source: Unleash a barrage of seeking missiles that deal Explosion Damage for a short duration.
entries.translation: 释放追踪导弹弹幕，在短时间内造成爆炸伤害。

entries.source: Vengeance
entries.translation: 复仇

entries.source:
For (duration), with each Attack a shadow of your past shoots a bullet that deals (damage) Damage.<lb>
While this ##skill is active you deal (bonusEffect).<lb>
(scaling)
(CastTime)
entries.translation:
持续(duration)期间，每次攻击都会让过去的你的影子射出一颗造成(damage)伤害的子弹。<lb>
该##技能生效时，你会造成(bonusEffect)。<lb>
(scaling)
(CastTime)

entries.source: For a short duration, with each Attack a shadow of your past also shoots a bullet.
entries.translation: 持续一小段时间，每次攻击都会让过去的你的影子也射出一颗子弹。

entries.source: Telekinetic Barrier
entries.translation: 念动力屏障

entries.source:
For (duration) deflect all Enemy Projectiles in a small radius around you dealing (damage) Damage.
<lb>This damage massively increases depending on the projectile.
<lb>You cannot ##attack while this ##skill is active and dashing prematurely ends it.<lb>
(scaling)
(CastTime)
entries.translation:
持续(duration)期间，偏转你周围小范围内所有敌方投射物，造成(damage)伤害。
<lb>该伤害会根据投射物大幅提高。
<lb>该##技能生效时你无法##攻击，提前冲刺会结束技能。<lb>
(scaling)
(CastTime)

entries.source: Deflect all Enemy Projectiles around you for a short duration, retaliating with Physical Damage.
entries.translation: 偏转周围所有敌方投射物，持续一小段时间，并以物理伤害反击。

entries.source: Rally Riffraff
entries.translation: 召集杂兵

entries.source:
Summon [[(count)]] (companionName) Companions<Companion> that each grants (companionEffect) for (duration).<lb>
(CastTime)
entries.translation:
召唤[[(count)]]个(companionName)同伴<Companion>，每个同伴会在(duration)期间赋予(companionEffect)。<lb>
(CastTime)

entries.source: Call in some Pirate Companions<Companion> for a short duration.
entries.translation: 召唤一些海盗同伴<Companion>，持续一小段时间。

entries.source: Dark Arts
entries.translation: 黑暗艺术

entries.source:
Turn intangible and gain (bonus) for (duration). During this time, any enemy you touch is marked and at the end every marked enemy takes (damage) Damage. 
<lb>If this Skill deals a Critical Hit<Crit> it also triggers your On Dash Effects.
<lb>You cannot ##attack while this ##skill is active and dashing prematurely ends it.<lb>
(CastTime)
entries.translation:
变得无形，并在(duration)期间获得(bonus)。期间，任何被你碰到的敌人都会被标记，结束时每个被标记的敌人受到(damage)伤害。 
<lb>如果该技能造成暴击<Crit>，还会触发你的冲刺时效果。
<lb>该##技能生效时你无法##攻击，提前冲刺会结束技能。<lb>
(CastTime)

entries.source: Turn intangible and mark Enemies by touching them, inflicting Damage when the Skill ends.
entries.translation: 变得无形，并通过接触标记敌人，技能结束时造成伤害。

entries.source: Summon Lich
entries.translation: 召唤巫妖

entries.source:
Summon a (companionName) Companion<Companion> that grants (companionEffect) for (duration).<lb>
(CastTime)
entries.translation:
召唤一个(companionName)同伴<Companion>，在(duration)期间赋予(companionEffect)。<lb>
(CastTime)

entries.source: Summon a powerful Lich Companion<Companion> for a short duration.
entries.translation: 召唤一名强大的巫妖同伴<Companion>，持续一小段时间。

entries.source: Heroic Flag
entries.translation: 英雄旗帜

entries.source:
Raise a flag and gain (bonus) for (duration).<lb>
(CastTime)
entries.translation:
举起旗帜并在(duration)期间获得(bonus)。<lb>
(CastTime)

entries.source: Raise a flag that grants an Attack Speed Buff to you and your Companions<Companion> for a short duration.
entries.translation: 举起旗帜，在短时间内为你和同伴<Companion>赋予攻击速度增益。

entries.source: Serenity
entries.translation: 宁静

entries.source:
Focus your mind and body to become invulnerable to all enemy damage for (duration).<lb>
Lasts an additional (bonusDuration) while unarmed.<lb>
Dashing costs [[0]] Stamina<Stamina> while this ##skill is active.
<lb>Prevents swapping Weapon while active.<lb>
(CastTime)
entries.translation:
集中精神与身体，在(duration)期间免疫所有敌方伤害。<lb>
未装备武器时额外持续(bonusDuration)。<lb>
该##技能生效时，冲刺消耗[[0]]体力<Stamina>。
<lb>激活期间无法切换武器。<lb>
(CastTime)

entries.source: Become Invulnerable to all Enemy Damage for a short duration.
entries.translation: 短时间内免疫所有敌方伤害。

entries.source: Twirl
entries.translation: 旋舞

entries.source:
On Dash, leave behind a Pose and consume any existing Pose.<lb>
Using this Skill consumes your Pose, teleporting you to its position.<lb>
Whenever a Pose is consumed, it deals (damage) Damage.<lb>
